name: Cross-Platform Music Release & Content OS
description: Managing promotional content across TikTok, Reels, Spotify, and link-in-bio tools creates extreme burnout and inconsistent organic visibility.
buyer: Solo musicians and independent artist managers juggling multi-channel promotion
core_problem: Managing promotional content across TikTok, Reels, Spotify, and link-in-bio tools creates extreme burnout and inconsistent organic visibility.
desired_outcome: Maintain a streamlined, repeatable release schedule and consistent organic reach across all major video and streaming channels without spending all day on social media.
current_solutions: Pitching releases to curated platform playlists
Cross-promoting music on short-form video apps like TikTok and Instagram Reels
Maintaining regular posting schedules using trending audio tracks
Focusing efforts on 1-2 primary channels where target fans spend time
Utilizing centralized analytics and link-in-bio tools
solution_gaps: Generic social media calendars aren't tailored for song release cycles or audio-centric platforms
Managing multiple fragmented channels leads to workflow friction and inconsistent posting
possible_product: All-in-one Notion/Airtable Music Release System, featuring pre-built content repurposing workflows, pitch trackers, and release timeline templates.
basis: Artists struggle with the heavy management burden of fragmented channels while competing in an over-saturated streaming market.

problems.statement: Extreme market saturation and algorithmic shifts make it difficult for independent artists to maintain organic visibility and steady playlist growth.
problems.normalized_problem: difficulty maintaining organic visibility amidst platform saturation
problems.desired_outcome: Achieve predictable organic discovery and steady listener growth across music platforms.
current_solutions: Pitching releases to curated platform playlists
Cross-promoting music on short-form video apps like TikTok and Instagram Reels
Maintaining regular posting schedules using trending audio tracks
attempts: Posting promotional social content three or more times per week
Adapting release strategies to fit platform algorithmic guidelines
solution_complaints: Sudden playlist or algorithm changes can cause severe, unexplained flatlines in follower growth
The constant influx of thousands of daily releases makes standing out nearly impossible without external push

problems.statement: Music discovery and audience building are fragmented across dozens of platforms, placing a heavy management burden on independent artists.
problems.desired_outcome: Streamline fan acquisition and profile management across multiple streaming and social channels.
current_solutions: Focusing efforts on 1-2 primary channels where target fans spend time
Utilizing centralized analytics and link-in-bio tools
attempts: Claiming and maintaining creator profiles across 9+ streaming services simultaneously
Creating unique short-form video and story content tailored to each platform
solution_complaints: Managing multiple dashboards, profiles, and analytics tools causes creator fatigue and burnout
Different platform best practices and audience expectations make unified growth strategies difficult to execute
